tip: без (bez = without) always takes the genitive, so ты (ty = you) becomes тебя (tebya = you).
For location, под (pod = under) takes the instrumental, so стол (stol = table) becomes столом (stolom = table).
For motion to a spot, под (pod = under) switches to the accusative: под кровать (pod krovat = under the bed).
скучать по (skuchat po = to miss) takes the dative, so дом (dom = home) becomes дому (domu = home).
перед (pered = before) takes the instrumental, so сон (son = sleep) becomes сном (snom = sleep).
через (cherez = through) always takes the accusative: через парк (cherez park = through the park).
For location, за (za = behind) takes the instrumental, so дерево (derevo = tree) becomes деревом (derevom = tree).
For moving about a place, по (po = around) takes the dative: по парку (po parku = around the park).
у (u = by) means right beside something and takes the genitive: у окна (u okna = by the window).
через (cherez = in) plus a time span means after that time: через час (cherez chas = in an hour).
в течение (v techenie = during) takes the genitive, so день (den = day) becomes дня (dnya = day).
In друг другу (drug drugu = each other) only the second word declines, dative here after помогают (pomogayut = help).
Numbers 2 to 4 force genitive singular on the noun: три года (tri goda = three years).
In reported speech the tense does not shift back: знают (znayut = know) stays present after past сказали (skazali = said).
Попрощавшись (Poproshchavshis = having said goodbye) is a perfective gerund: the action finishes before the main verb.
из-под (iz-pod = from under) is a single preposition taking the genitive: из-под кровати (iz-pod krovati = from under the bed).
For a range, с (s = from) and до (do = until) both take the genitive: с девяти до пяти (s devyati do pyati = from nine to five).
After ordering or wishing, чтобы (chtoby = that) takes a past-tense verb: чтобы я убрал (chtoby ya ubral = that I clean up).
Borrowed words like метро (metro = metro) never change form, staying метро (metro) in every case.
The verb ответить (otvetit = answer) needs на (na = to) plus accusative: ответил на сообщение (otvetil na soobshchenie = answered the message).
Weeks take на (na = in), not в (v): на прошлой неделе (na proshloy nedele = last week), prepositional case.
Говоря (Govorya = while talking) is an imperfective gerund: it happens at the same time as ходила (khodila = was walking).
между (mezhdu = between) takes the instrumental, so дом (dom = house) becomes домами (domami = houses) in the plural.
